## Isolate the System

<!-- STEP id="isolate" -->
Isolate the box together with its movable pulley — treat them as ONE system, exactly like you've done before.

<!-- STEP id="two-segments-same-t" -->
## Two Segments, One Tension

Two string segments hold this system up: one from the fixed ceiling point, one heading to the fixed pulley and your hand.

Both carry the same tension $T$ — it's all one string, over ideal pulleys.

<!-- STEP id="balance" -->
## Both Pull Up

To hold the system still, the two segments must together balance its weight:

$$2T = W$$

<!-- STEP id="half-force" -->
## Half the Force

$$T = \frac{W}{2}$$

**Two segments share the load — you only need to pull with half the box's weight.**
